findings.title: Completed extracted files show over 100% and lose completion indicators
findings.body: For local_size=20 and remote_size=10, this now emits 200 instead of 100. These supported extracted-file sizes are explicitly covered in view-file.service.spec.ts:245–247. transfer-row.component.html renders the percentage directly at line 28 and requires exactly 100 for success styling (line 33) and the Done label (line 53). Its width clamp at line 35 does not protect those consumers, so completed files display 200% and lose completion indicators. The existing percentage test also expects 100 for this input.
findings.recommendation: Restore the Math.min(100, ...) clamp and run the existing ViewFileService percentage test.
